risks.title: Regulatory risk
risks.score_rationale: Regulators (CPUC, FERC, PUCT) can modify rules and authorized rates of return, which could impact company results. The company experienced disallowances of $432M in 2025.

risks.title: Credit risk
risks.score_rationale: The company carries significant debt and changes in credit conditions could impact its ability to finance capital investments.

risks.title: Interest rate risk
risks.score_rationale: Changes in interest rates can impact the value of company assets and liabilities and financing costs for capital investments.

risks.title: Asset impairment and impairment risk
risks.score_rationale: Company assets, particularly SI Partners and Ecogas (classified as assets held for sale), may require significant impairments if market or regulatory conditions change.

risks.title: Tax and foreign exchange risk
risks.score_rationale: Changes in tax laws and foreign exchange rate fluctuations (particularly in Mexico) could impact company results. Foreign exchange impact in 2025 was $445M unfavorable.

risks.title: Pension plan risk
risks.score_rationale: Company pension plans may require significant contributions if market or demographic conditions change.
